# veraPDF corpus

For full corpus investigations, obtain the [veraPDF test corpus](https://github.com/veraPDF/veraPDF-corpus)
directly from the veraPDF Consortium. The validation profiles for veraPDF
1.30 used [commit 49de56c](https://github.com/veraPDF/veraPDF-corpus/tree/49de56cd987929932c9e4fbbbe67d052bf44ef83).
Its upstream archive has SHA-256
`5c1a138e0fd89fafa51d03a23a1a0bf0a9bcb028430e1d5dd125364e19b87f57`.

The veraPDF corpus is copyright the veraPDF Consortium and contributors.
